blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Dialogue and collaborative assistants repeatedly judge what a partner knows, believes, or intends. Typed decision models offer a potential alternative to generative large language models for bounded Theory of Mind (ToM) selection. We present Jev-ToM, comparing five typed decision models and seven generative baselines on 11,117 English text questions from nine ToM benchmarks across six capability groups. TypeSafe Jev reaches 73.2% source-balanced accuracy including native controls and ranks first or second across all six capabilities, leading beliefs, goals/desires/intentions, and emotions. Other typed models show distinct strengths across tasks. Separate resource comparisons suggest that Jev could reduce the cost and waiting time of repeated ToM selection. Confidence-based selection remains benchmark-dependent, and supplied reasons can repair errors or overturn correct answers depending on their attachment. Candidate expansion reveals distinct selection and output-validity problems. Related-question cues account for most of Jev's downstream gains, with task-dependent effects from predicted states. The findings motivate testing Jev as a ToM selection component in assistants, with task-specific confidence calibration, candidate design, and output validation as integration priorities.
blocks.zh: 对话和协作助理反复判断伙伴知道、相信或打算做什么。 所打出的决定模型提供了一种潜在的替代基因大语言模型,用于选择有界限的Mind理论(Tom). 我们介绍了Jev-Tom,比较了六个能力组的9个Tom基准的11,117个英文文本问题上的5个打入式决定模型和7个基因基线。 类型安全 Jev达到了73.2%的源平衡精确度,包括本土控制,在所有六种能力中排名第一或第二,主要信仰、目标/期望/意图和情感。 其他打字模型显示出不同任务的不同优势。 单独的资源比较表明,Jev可以减少重复的Tom选择的成本和等待时间. 基于信心的选择仍然依赖于基准,提供的理由可以修复错误或推翻正确答案,视其附件而定. 候选人的扩充显示出明显的甄选和产出有效性问题。 相关问题提示占了Jev下游的大部分收益,其任务依赖效应来自预测状态. 这些结果促使将Jev作为助理的Tom选择部分进行测试,将特定任务的信心校准、候选人设计和产出验证作为整合的优先事项。

blocks.en: Theory of Mind (ToM) is the ability to attribute mental states, such as beliefs, knowledge, and intentions, to others and use them to interpret or predict behavior ( Premack and Woodruff, 1978 ) . Advances in the language and reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) have brought increasing attention to their ability to reason about others’ perspectives ( Strachan et al., 2024 ; Chan et al., 2026 ) . Useful interactive responses depend on the recipient’s perspective , including missed information and outdated beliefs.
blocks.zh: Mind (TOM)的理论是将信仰,知识和意向等精神状态归于他人,并用它们来解释或预测行为的能力(Premack and Woodruff, 1978.). 大型语言模型(LLMs)的语言和推理能力的进步,使他们越来越关注其解释他人观点的能力(Strachan等,2024;Chan等,2026). 有效的互动反应取决于接受者的观点,包括遗漏的信息和过时的信念。

blocks.en: Agents use mental-state inferences for action selection and response generation. Collaborative agents update explicit belief states from observations for planning ( Li et al., 2023 ) . Dialogue agents use generative LLMs, including compact models, to infer participants’ mental states from conversation and condition responses on those inferences ( Hwang et al., 2026 ) . For example, ToM-agent tracks a partner’s beliefs, desires, and intentions in simulated persuasion dialogues, such as attempts to encourage a donation ( Yang et al., 2025 ) . It maintains candidate interpretations, revises them using observed and predicted replies, and conditions its next response on the candidate with the highest confidence. The authors identify repeated LLM calls and long prompts as sources of waiting time and cost ( Yang et al., 2025 ) . Repeated mental-state selection motivates testing Jev for candidate-based judgments in dialogue and collaboration, with candidate generation and response composition left to the surrounding system. Such intermediate judgments can have finite alternatives, even when final responses require open-ended language.
blocks.zh: 特工们使用精神状态推论进行动作选择和反应生成. 合作机构更新了从观察中得出的明确的信念,以便进行规划(Li等,2023年)。 对话代理商使用遗传性LLMs,包括紧凑模型,从这些推断的谈话和条件反应中推断参与者的精神状态(Hwang等,2026年). 例如,Tom-Agent在模拟说服对话中追踪伴侣的信仰、欲望和意图,例如鼓励捐赠的尝试(Yang等人,2025年)。 它维持对候选人的解释,使用观察和预测的答复加以修订,并以最有信心的条件对候选人作出下一次答复。 提交人指出,重复的LLM呼叫和长时间的提示是等待时间和成本的来源(Yang等人,2025年)。 反复的心理状态选择促使Jev在对话和协作中测试基于候选人的判断,而候选人的生成和反应组成则留给了周围的系统. 这种中间判决可以有有限的替代办法,即使最后答复需要开放式语言。

blocks.en: Typed decision models offer a direct interface for bounded judgments ( Wang, 2026 ; Deußer et al., 2026 ) . Given context, a question, and candidates, TypeSafe Jev (hereafter Jev) returns a selection and candidate probabilities as structured outputs ( TypeSafe AI, 2026 ) . Its design targets fast, inexpensive decisions ( Almeida, 2026 ) . Structured selection makes Jev a promising candidate for bounded ToM judgments currently performed by generative LLMs. Fulfilling this role requires accurate mental-state judgments at low time and cost.
blocks.zh: 型式决定模型为受约束的判决提供了直接的界面(Wang, 2026;Deußer等, 2026.). 鉴于背景,一个问题,以及候选人,TypeSafe Jev(以下简称Jev)将选择和候选人概率作为结构化产出(TypeSafe AI, 2026.)返回. 其设计目标是快速,廉价的决定(Almeida,2026年). 结构化的选择使得Jev成为目前由基因分类LLMs执行的有界限的Tom判断的有希望的候选人. 履行这一角色需要以低时间和成本做出准确的精神状态判断.

blocks.en: Fast, structured output alone does not establish suitability for this role. A high overall score can conceal differences between tracking knowledge, attributing beliefs or emotions, and applying mental states to behavior. Moreover, an agent needs to know when a selection is reliable and whether supplied reasons alter the choice or break the required output format. This raises a research question: How competitive and reliable is Jev as a bounded ToM decision component?
blocks.zh: 仅靠快速、结构化的产出并不能确定是否适合发挥这一作用。 高整体分数可以掩盖追踪知识,将信仰或情感归属,将精神状态应用于行为之间的区别. 此外,代理人需要知道选择何时是可靠的,提供的理由是改变选择还是打破所需的产出格式。 这就提出了一个研究问题: Jev作为一个受约束的Tom决策部分具有多大的竞争力和可靠性?

blocks.en: We present Jev-ToM, a systematic framework for evaluating Jev’s ToM capabilities. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first dedicated evaluation of Jev’s ToM capabilities across multiple benchmarks organized into explicitly defined capability groups. We compare five typed decision models and seven generative baselines on 11,117 questions from nine existing ToM benchmarks across six operational capability groups, as shown in Figure 1 . We examine confidence-based answer selection, interference from supplied reasons, and output validity, alongside observed response time and reference-price cost.
blocks.zh: 我们提出Jev-Tom,这是评价Jev的Tom能力的系统框架。 据我们所知,这是首次专门评估Jev的Tom能力,涉及多个基准,分成明确界定的能力组。 如图1所示,我们比较了6个业务能力组的9个现有Tom基准中的5个打入式决定模型和7个基因基线问题。 我们审查了基于信任的答案选择、来自所提供理由的干扰和产出有效性,以及观察到的反应时间和参考价格成本。

blocks.en: Our results show that competitive accuracy can coexist with benchmark-dependent confidence errors, while supplied reasons can improve or disrupt selections depending on their attachment and the evaluated materials. The evaluation identifies confidence calibration, candidate sensitivity, and output validity as priorities for integration testing. Our contributions are threefold:
blocks.zh: 我们的结果显示,竞争准确性可以与依赖基准的信任出错并存,而提供的理由可以根据附件和被评价的材料改进或中断选择。 评价确定信心校准、候选人敏感性和产出有效性是综合测试的优先事项。 我们的贡献有三个方面:

blocks.en: • We compare Jev and generative LLMs across ToM tasks, measuring accuracy, reference cost, and observed response time. • We diagnose Jev’s reliability through confidence-based selection and candidate interventions, separating selection errors from output-validity failures obscured by aggregate accuracy. • We investigate supplied reasons and mental-state feedback, testing reason attachment and separating the contributions of related-question cues and predicted states.
blocks.zh: 二. 支助 我们比较Jev和基因LLMs在Tom任务中,测量准确性、参考成本和观察到的反应时间。 我们通过基于信任的甄选和候选人干预来判断Jev的可靠性,把甄选错误与产出-有效性失败区分开来,后者被整体准确性所掩盖。 我们调查提供的理由和精神状态的反馈,测试理由的依附性,区分相关问题提示和预测状态的贡献。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Mental-state judgments support cooperative planning ( Li et al., 2023 ) , dialogue perspective tracking ( Qiu et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2025 ) , response selection ( Hwang et al., 2026 ) , and action prediction ( Mu et al., 2026 ) . These uses motivate evaluating intermediate mental-state judgments in agents. ToM benchmarks differ in what successful judgment requires: controlled belief attribution and higher-order perspectives (beliefs about another person’s beliefs) ( Le et al., 2019 ; Gandhi et al., 2023 ; Wu et al., 2023 ) , conversational information asymmetry ( Kim et al., 2023 ) , or diverse psychological states and social situations ( Xu et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2024 ; Tong et al., 2026 ; Shinoda et al., 2025 ) . SimpleToM separates mental-state inference from behavior prediction and judgment ( Gu et al., 2026 ) , while NegotiationToM studies inference in human negotiations ( Chan et al., 2024 ) . This variety makes scope and aggregation choices central to interpreting a ToM score.
blocks.zh: 精神状态判断支持合作规划(李等,2023年),对话视角跟踪(邱等,2024年;杨等,2025年),反应选择(黄等,2026年),行动预测(缪等,2026年). 这些用法激励了对代理人中间精神状态判断的评价。 TOM基准在成功的判断要求上有所不同:受控制的信仰归属和更高阶的视角(对他人信仰的信仰)(Le等,2019;Gandhi等,2023;Wu等,2023;对话信息不对称(Kim等,2023),或不同的心理状态和社会状况(Xu等,2024;Chen等,2024;Tong等,2026;Shinoda等,2025)。 简单 TOM将精神状态推论与行为预测和判断区分开来(Gu等,2026年),而谈判TOM研究人类谈判推论(Chan等,2024年). 这种多样性使范围和汇总选择成为解释Tom分数的核心。

blocks.en: Typed decision interfaces expose choices, scores, and probabilities for software to consume ( Almeida, 2026 ; TypeSafe AI, 2026 ) . Mnemon uses Jev to evaluate retrieved records while LLM plans searches and composes responses ( Wang, 2026 ) . This division motivates a similar component role for mental-state selection. Broad Jev evaluations already examine task performance, calibration, and resource use ( Deußer et al., 2026 ) , alongside annotation and rubric assessment ( Ibrahim and Zaki, 2026 ; Rao and Callison-Burch, 2026 ) . Adversarial and option-definition studies establish that structured outputs can remain sensitive to request content ( Hu et al., 2026 ; Sun et al., 2026 ) . JevOut also includes ToMBench when testing contextual additions that redirect decisions ( Xu et al., 2026 ) . We extend these studies by connecting cross-benchmark ToM profiles with confidence-based selection, bidirectional changes under supplied reasons, and output validity.
blocks.zh: 被打出的决定界面暴露出软件消费的选择,分数和概率(Almeida,2026;TypeSafe AI,2026.). Mnemon使用Jev来评价取回的记录,而LLM则计划搜索并作曲回复(Wang, 2026). . 这个部门激励着精神状态选择的类似角色。 宽度 Jev评价已经审查了任务业绩、校正和资源使用情况(Deußer等,2026年),并附有注释和说明(Ibrahim和Zaki,2026年;Rao和Callison-Burch,2026年)。 横向和选项定义研究确定,结构化产出仍能敏感地要求内容(Hu等,2026;Sun等,2026)。 JevOut在测试可改变决定方向的上下文添加时也包括了TOMBench(Xu等,2026年). 我们扩展这些研究,将跨基准的Tom配置与基于信任的选择、提供的理由下的双向变化和输出有效性联系起来。

blocks.en: 3 Experiments
blocks.zh: 3个实验

blocks.en: To assess breadth and reliability in bounded ToM selection, we compare performance on fixed answer choices and examine confidence, supplied reasons, and resource use in separate subsets of models and questions.
blocks.zh: 为了在定界的Tom选择中评估宽度和可靠性,我们比较了固定答案选择的性能,并审查了信心、提供的理由和资源使用情况。

blocks.en: 3.1 Theory of Mind Ability Categories
blocks.zh: 3.1 思维能力类别理论

blocks.en: We adapt Abilities in Theory of Mind Space (ATOMS) to group questions by the mental states they concern ( Beaudoin et al., 2020 ) . Knowledge access covers information available through observation and communication ( Kim et al., 2023 ) . Beliefs concern representations of the world and others’ perspectives ( Gandhi et al., 2023 ; Wu et al., 2023 ) . Goals, desires, and intentions group related preferences and planned actions for cross-source comparison ( Xu et al., 2024 ) . Emotions covers feelings ( Shinoda et al., 2025 ) , while social pragmatics groups socially situated and non-literal meaning ( Chen et al., 2024 ) . CogToM’s native Percept items remain in benchmark totals but outside capability groups pending finer mapping.
blocks.zh: 我们调整了心灵空间理论(ATOMS)中的能力,以适应他们所关注的精神状态(Beaudoin等人,2020年)的分组问题。 知识获取涵盖通过观察和交流获得的信息(Kim等人,2023年)。 信仰涉及世界的表达和他人的观点(甘地等,2023;吴等,2023.). 目标、愿望和意向将相关偏好和计划行动分组,进行跨源比较(徐等,2024年). 情感涵盖感情(Shinoda等,2025年),而社会实用主义群体则具有社会定位和非文学意义(Chen等,2024年)。 CogTOM的原生感知项目仍为基准总数,

blocks.en: Mental-state application adds a different dimension: using a perspective to predict, select, or judge behavior ( Gu et al., 2026 ) . A question asking what someone believes concerns attribution, whereas one asking how that belief affects their action concerns application. Application can overlap the state categories because it describes a task demand. Figure 1 also shows unequal source coverage: beliefs draw on eight benchmarks, while social pragmatics draws on two. These profiles compare models over the specified question groups.
blocks.zh: 精神状态应用增加了一个不同的维度:使用视角来预测,选择或判断行为(Gu等,2026.). 询问某人认为什么涉及归属的问题,而询问该信仰如何影响其行动的问题涉及适用。 应用程序可以重复状态类别,因为它描述了任务需求. 图1还显示了不平等的来源覆盖面:信仰借鉴了8个基准,而社会务实则借鉴了2个基准。 这些剖面图将模型比作指定的问题组.

blocks.en: 3.2 Dataset Selection and Harmonization
blocks.zh: 3.2 数据集选择和统一

blocks.en: We assemble a common evaluation from nine existing ToM benchmarks with English contexts, reference answers, and discrete candidate choices ( Gandhi et al., 2023 ; Le et al., 2019 ; Wu et al., 2023 ; Kim et al., 2023 ; Xu et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2024 ; Tong et al., 2026 ; Shinoda et al., 2025 ; Gu et al., 2026 ) . Table 1 summarizes the evaluated subsets. We use normal-length discrete OpenToM, short-context discrete FANToM, English ToMBench, and the ToMi subset accompanying SimToM ( Wilf et al., 2024 ) . The collection consists of fixed development or previously used subsets, not newly collected questions. Appendix B.2 gives their scope.
blocks.zh: 我们收集了对9个现有Tom基准的共同评价,这些基准有英文背景、参考答案和独立的候选人选择(甘地等,2023年;勒等,2019年;吴等,2023年;金等,2023年;徐等,2024年;陈等,2024年;汤等,2026年;希诺达等,2025年;古等,2026年)。 表1汇总了评价的子集。 我们使用正常长度的离散OpenTOM,短文本离散FANTOM,英语TOMBench,以及伴随SimTOM的TOM子集(Wilf等,2024年). 集合由固定开发或以前使用的子集组成,不是新收集的问题. 附录B.2说明了其范围。

blocks.en: Source-specific adapters convert each question into a shared record containing source and question identifiers, a question family , context, question, candidate texts, and a reference answer. Families group related questions or scenario variants using source identifiers or shared contexts, so a BigToM family can span multiple story variants. We retain the source contexts without truncation and preserve task-specific candidate meanings. Candidate counts remain unequal, ranging from two to fifteen. Harmonization therefore standardizes the evaluation record while retaining the original decision task.
blocks.zh: 特定源的适配器将每个问题转换成包含源和问题识别符,问题家族,上下文,问题,候选文本,以及参考答案的共享记录. 家庭利用源识别符或共享上下文将相关问题或情景变体分组,因此一个BigTOM家族可以跨越多个故事变体. 我们保留源背景,不截断,保留特定任务候选人的含义。 候选人人数仍然不平等,从2人到15人不等。 因此,在保留原先的决定任务的同时,统一评价记录。

blocks.en: We check that fields are nonempty, candidates are distinct, and references identify an offered answer. Of the initial 11,167 questions, we exclude 50 BigToM items for every model because their stories omit the subsequent event required by the reference. The resulting 11,117 questions and each question’s candidate order are frozen across primary models. References are retained for scoring and withheld from model inputs. Source and family identifiers preserve the connection between standardized records and related judgments.
blocks.zh: 我们检查一下,字段是空的,候选人是不同的,参考文献列出了一个答案。 在最初的11,167个问题中,我们排除了每个模型的50个BigTOM项目,因为他们的故事省略了参考要求的随后事件. 由此产生的11 117个问题和每个问题的候选人顺序被冻结在主要模式中。 保留评分参考文献,不列入模型投入。 来源和家庭识别资料保持标准化记录与相关判断之间的联系。

blocks.en: We then map native task, ability, or mental-state labels to the six capability groups. ToMBench application additionally follows the requested behavior prediction, selection, or judgment. All 730 ToMBench question targets underwent an agent-assisted post-evaluation review without item-level model predictions. This was not independent human validation. A question may enter multiple capability groups but counts once in its benchmark total. Appendix B.1 provides the mapping rules.
blocks.zh: 然后,我们将本地的任务,能力,或精神状态标签映射到六个能力组. ToMBench应用程序还遵循了所要求的行为预测、选择或判断。 所有730个TOMBench问题目标都进行了由代理人协助的后评价审查,但没有进行项目一级模型预测。 这不是独立的人类验证。 一个问题可能进入多个能力组,但按基准总数计算一次。 附录B.1提供绘图规则。

blocks.en: Figure 2 ranks Jev first or second in every capability, with its largest lead over the strongest generative baseline in emotions: 84.8% against GPT-3.5’s 79.7%. Strong relative rankings still leave substantial errors in beliefs and mental-state application, Jev’s lowest-scoring capabilities. The other typed models remain below Jev but differ in their strengths. Open-Jev-2B leads this group in four capabilities, while Valen leads beliefs and OpenJev-0.6B social pragmatics. Tiny-Jev exceeds OpenJev-0.6B on emotions, reaching 55.2% against 43.5%, yet trails it on application. Application is the strongest capability for Open-Jev-2B, Valen, and OpenJev-0.6B, whereas Tiny-Jev favors emotions. Broad competitiveness is therefore a result for Jev, and the shared typed interface does not make the models interchangeable.

blocks.en: Table 2 shows why overall rank is insufficient for model selection. Removing native controls reverses Jev’s lead over GPT-3.5, leaving 69.1% against 70.9%. Rankings also reverse within a specific benchmark: Open-Jev-2B reaches 72.0% on ToMi against Jev’s 69.7%, despite trailing substantially overall. Appendices C.1 and C.2 provide capability breakdowns and control-free comparisons. Choosing a ToM component consequently requires matching its strengths to the intended tasks, rather than relying on a single aggregate score.

blocks.en: Figure 3 compares Jev’s answer selection at a descriptive selected-answer probability cutoff of 0.90 across all 11,117 primary responses. Coverage is the fraction retained and retained error their error rate. Seven benchmarks fall below 10% retained error, but SimpleToM and OpenToM remain at 34.9% and 29.0%. Similar coverage can therefore conceal very different reliability: ToMATO and SimpleToM both retain about 47% of answers, yet their retained errors are 1.8% and 34.9%. Conversely, Hi-ToM’s zero observed errors concern only 33 retained answers. Appendices D.1 and D.2 provide counts and risk–coverage curves. blocks.en: 4.3 Intervention 1: How Do Supplied Reasons Affect Selection?
blocks.zh: 4.3 干预1:应用理由如何影响选择?

blocks.en: We compare six conditions with questions, answer choices, and Jev settings fixed. The keyed reason supports the reference answer, and the foil reason supports a selected incorrect answer. Aligned reasons accompany their own answers, swapped reasons exchange these two attachments, and shared conditions repeat either reason across answers. No-reason and neutral-text controls complete the comparison. Jev selects only an answer on 249 historically correct and 1,554 historically incorrect questions, each in original and reversed orders. Figure 4 shows aligned reasons raising fresh accuracy on earlier-correct cases from 96.4% to 99.0%, while swapping lowers it to 25.3%. Neutral text preserves 96.8%, so extra text alone does not explain the loss. On earlier errors, aligned and shared keyed reasons reach 71.0% and 69.4% against a fresh 10.0% baseline. Appendix E.2 details sampling and conditions. Recovery can occur without option-specific support, yet misleading attachment can overturn a correct selection.

blocks.en: In a separate eight-model study, materials pair existing questions with supplied reasons. Three coauthors assessed reason support and attachment on an initial 450-question sample, with methods and majority-reference results in Appendix E.3 . Models select bare answers or complete answer–reason pairs. Aligned pairs preserve each attachment, while crossing includes all K 2 K^{2} combinations of K K answers and reasons, including the keyed pair. Figure 5 compares the 1,803 preceding error-enriched materials, termed reused , with new reasons for 2,958 other existing questions. All gains use strict answer-component accuracy and equal benchmark weights. Aligned gains shrink on new materials for every model: Jev falls from 51.4 to 3.7 points, below Open-Jev-2B’s 8.3-point gain. Crossed gains are lower still for all eight models and negative for five. Jev’s Repair and Damage panel explains why the net effect is insufficient. Against matched no-reason answers, repair changes errors to correct answers and damage loses previously correct answers. From aligned to crossed, repair stays near seven points while damage rises from 3.3 to 7.1. Thus, 13.8% of weighted outcomes change strict correctness despite a net − 0.4 -0.4 points. Crossing also increases candidate count and repetition. Appendix E.4 details material selection and repair–damage scoring. Reason sensitivity must therefore be assessed against both the material selection and the underlying changes in correctness.

blocks.en: Figure 6 separates answer/reason correctness from output validity in the same crossed responses, using benchmark-equal outcome shares. Strict joint accuracy requires valid output with both components matching their keys. Every model selects only the keyed reason more often than only the keyed answer. For Llama, the shares are 23.8% and 13.0%, showing that selecting supplied support does not ensure a correct answer. Similar joint scores also conceal different failure profiles: Jev and Luna achieve 78.2% and 77.6% both-correct outcomes, but their invalid or failed shares are 7.5% and less than 0.1%, respectively. Open-Jev-2B rarely fails validation, yet its keyed-reason/wrong-answer share reaches 13.5%. Appendix E.6 details probability validation and output diagnostics. blocks.en: To separate attachment from candidate expansion, we test 108 questions, one per family, using an eight-pair baseline that repeats four answers and four reasons twice. Reattachment changes only pairs with neither reference component. Expansion instead includes all sixteen combinations and changes repetition. Figure 7 shows reattachment helping both models, while expansion reduces accuracy, including a 13.9-point GPT-3.5 loss despite valid outputs. Jev’s strict accuracy falls from 81.0% to 76.4%. Post-hoc saved-choice scoring reads selections despite invalid probabilities without repairing them. Its smaller decline widens the strict-to-saved gap from 3.2 to 6.0 points, distinguishing selection loss from additional validation failures. Appendix E.5 gives the protocol. Even when the correct pair remains available, expanding the candidates can impair both selection and output validity.

blocks.en: Table 3 compares five typed models on 400 behavior-prediction questions from families outside the primary sample. Each target shares a story with a belief/awareness question. We compare fresh original controls with question-only cues supplying the related question, predicted-state feedback adding the same model’s answer, and flipped-state feedback supplying the other binary answer, which need not be wrong. Question cues account for 10.75 of Jev’s 14.5-point gain, with a further 3.75 points from adding the predicted answer. That extra gain concentrates on SimpleToM, where a post-hoc offline fixed-No replay of saved calls also reaches 88.5% and reproduces every predicted-feedback selection. BigToM changes little across the three additions. Tiny-Jev favors question-only, while predicted feedback reduces accuracy for Open-Jev-2B, Valen, and OpenJev-0.6B relative to their original controls. Appendix F.2 details the replay and fixed-versus-predicted comparisons. Related-question cues can improve action selection, but the recorded gains do not establish a benefit from instance-specific mental-state predictions.
blocks.zh: 表3比较了主样本外家庭400个行为预测问题的5个打入模型. 每个目标都有一个信仰/认识问题的故事。 我们比较新的原始控件与只提供相关问题的提问提示,预测态反馈添加同一模型的答案,并翻转态反馈提供另一个二进制答案,这不需要错误. 问题提示占了Jev14.5分收益的10.75分,加上预测的答案还有3.75分。 这个额外收益集中在SimpleTOM上,其中后热离线固定不重播被保存的呼叫也达到了88.5%,并复制了每一个预测的回馈选择. BigTom在三个加法之间变化不大。 Tiny-Jev偏好只问,而预测回馈则会降低Open-Jev-2B,Valen,和OpenJev-0.6B相对于原控的准确性. 附录F.2详细介绍了重播和固定与预测的比较. 相关问题提示可以改善动作选择,但记录的收益并不能确立具体实例心理状态预测的好处.

blocks.en: 4.5 What Are the Cost–Time Tradeoffs?
blocks.zh: 4.5 成本-时间权衡是什么?

blocks.en: Figure 8 compares eight deployments on 11,117 questions, with seven priced using frozen OpenRouter reference tariffs. At US$0.0295 per 1,000 questions, Jev costs 32.7% less than nano and 56.3% less than mini, with 11.7- and 6.7-point accuracy advantages. Lower cost alone does not favor Jev universally: DeepSeek offers US$0.0138 at 65.4% accuracy, giving Jev 7.6 more points at 2.14 times the cost. DeepSeek’s longer observed response time also shows that lower cost need not mean less waiting. Jev’s separate timing run records 73.0% accuracy and a 282 ms mean response time, the highest accuracy and shortest mean in this cohort. Its mean is 83.9% below nano and 82.3% below mini. Open-Jev-2B follows at 464 ms with 56.6% accuracy and appears only in the time comparison because it lacks a matching tariff. Appendix G gives settings and full values. Observed timings reflect differing hardware, concurrency, and retry settings. Shorter decision calls could reduce waiting in assistants making repeated sequential judgments, but the overall benefit depends on the cost and time of generating candidates and composing responses, which this experiment does not measure.
blocks.zh: 图8比较了11,117个问题的8个部署,其中7个采用冻结的OpenRouter参考关税定价。 按每1 000个问题0.0295美元计算, Jev比纳米低32.7%,比微型低56.3%,具有11.7%和6.7分的精度优势. 仅低成本并不普遍有利于Jev:DeepSeek以65.4%的精度提供0.0138美元,以2.14倍成本给予Jev7.6多分. DeepSeek观察的反应时间较长也表明,成本降低并不意味着等待时间减少。 Jev的单独计时记录为73.0%的准确度,282 ms表示反应时间,是这一组中最高的准确度和最短的平均值。 其平均值为:纳米以下83.9%;微型以下82.3%. Open-Jev-2B以464 ms的速度跟踪,精确度为56.6%,并仅出现在时间比较中,因为它缺乏相匹配的关税. 附 录 G给出设置和全部值. 所观察的时间反映了不同的硬件、货币和重试设置。 更短的决定电话可以减少助理在重复进行顺序判断时的等待,但总的好处取决于产生候选人和编组答复的成本和时间,而这项试验并不衡量。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: Jev-ToM shows that Jev combines competitive bounded ToM selection with favorable reference-cost and observed-time comparisons in the evaluated deployments. Benchmark-dependent confidence errors and sensitivity to supplied reasons show why accuracy alone is insufficient for adoption. The results prioritize task-specific confidence calibration, candidate design, and output validation before testing Jev within complete assistants.
blocks.zh: Jev-Tom显示,Jev将竞争性的限定的Tom选择与评价部署中有利的参考成本和观察时间比较结合起来。 依赖基准的信心错误和对所提供理由的敏感性表明,单靠准确性不足以通过。 结果在Jev在完全助理内部进行测试之前,优先考虑特定任务的信心校正,候选设计和产出验证.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Our evaluation is limited to English, text-based questions with supplied candidates. The nine benchmarks cover several forms of ToM judgment, but their results do not establish generalization to other languages, cultural settings, or multimodal social situations. The six capability groups summarize the included tasks and are not an exhaustive measure of ToM. Possible training exposure to the public benchmarks also cannot be excluded.
blocks.zh: 我们的评价仅限于英文、文本和提供候选人的问题。 这9个基准涵盖多种形式的Tom判断,但其结果并没有确定对其他语言、文化环境或多模式社会状况的概括。 6个能力小组总结了包含的任务,并非对Tom的详尽衡量,也不能排除可能的培训与公共基准的接触。

blocks.en: We evaluate Jev as a bounded decision component, without testing its integration into a complete interactive assistant. Candidate generation, partner-state updates across turns, and interactive task success are therefore outside our empirical claims. The confidence and reason analyses are exploratory, and the descriptive 0.90 cutoff is not a validated acceptance policy. The observed accuracy and resource advantages concern the evaluated tasks and deployments, so their value in a complete system depends on the surrounding components.
blocks.zh: 我们评价Jev是一个有限度的决定部分,而没有测试将其纳入一个完整的互动助理。 因此,候选人的产生、伙伴国家的最新数据以及互动任务的成功不属于我们的经验性主张。 信心和理性分析是探索性的,描述性的0.90截断不是经过验证的接受政策. 观察到的准确性和资源优势涉及评估的任务和部署,因此,这些任务和部署在一个完整的系统中的价值取决于周围的组成部分。

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: This study uses existing benchmark situations, model outputs, and annotations by three postgraduate students at English-medium universities with prior experience annotating ToM benchmarks. Annotation procedures are provided in Appendix E.3 . It does not infer sensitive attributes of real users. Social-decision components can nevertheless harm users when predictions about beliefs or intentions are treated as facts. Applications should distinguish observed information from inferred states and validate the consequences of their errors. Our results do not justify autonomous consequential decisions about individuals. Dataset and model redistribution remains subject to source terms, with the planned release described in Appendix I .
blocks.zh: 这项研究利用了现有基准情况、示范产出以及有以往经验的英文中专大学三名研究生的说明。 说明程序载于附录E.3。 它不推断真实用户的敏感属性. 然而,如果将关于信仰或意图的预测视为事实,社会决策要素仍会伤害使用者。 申请应区分所观察到的信息与推断的状态并验证其错误的后果。 我们的结果不能成为对个人作出自主的间接决定的理由。 数据集和模型再分配仍受源词制约,计划发布内容见附录一.

blocks.en: To support reproducibility, we plan to release a versioned package containing evaluation materials, subset and family identifiers, candidate-order mappings, per-question predictions and available probability vectors, de-identified annotation-stage records, and executable scoring and family-level resampling code. The package will cover the reason interventions and matched-candidate analyses, with source attribution and redistribution governed by the original licenses. Appendix I describes the planned release.
blocks.zh: 为了支持可复制性,我们计划发布一个版本包,其中包含评价材料、子集和家庭识别符、候选人顺序图、每个问题预测和可用概率矢量、去识别的注释阶段记录以及可执行的评分和家庭级再样码。 该一揽子计划将涵盖理由干预和相应的候选人分析,来源的归属和再分配由原始许可证管理。 附录一介绍了计划的发布情况。

blocks.en: We used GPT-6.1-Sol to generate and separately review the reason materials. These supplied reasons are experimental candidate text, not explanations produced by the evaluated models. Construction and prompts are documented in Appendices E.1 and J , respectively. Language-model assistance also supported the question-target mapping audit, analysis-code preparation, and manuscript revision. The authors remain responsible for the methods, claims, and final publication.

blocks.en: A.1 ToM benchmarks and application
blocks.zh: A.1 Tom基准和适用

blocks.en: ToM evaluations differ in the evidence available to a character and the reasoning required of a model. ToMi controls answer-space regularities that allowed earlier tasks to be solved through dataset biases ( Le et al., 2019 ) . BigToM uses causal templates for belief and action questions, while Hi-ToM extends perspective tracking to recursively nested beliefs ( Gandhi et al., 2023 ; Wu et al., 2023 ) . Small alterations to otherwise similar tasks can also expose failures concealed by average success ( Ullman, 2023 ) . Task structure and perspective depth therefore matter when interpreting a ToM score.
blocks.zh: Tom评价在特征可用证据和模型所需推理方面各不相同。 TOMI 控制答案- 空间规律, 允许通过数据集偏差解决先前的任务( Le等, 2019) . BigTOM对信仰和行动问题使用因果模板,而Hi-TOM则将视角跟踪延伸至递归的嵌入式信仰(Gandhi等,2023;Wu等,2023.). 对原本相似的任务稍作修改,也可能暴露出被一般成功掩盖的失败(Ullman,2023.). 因此,任务结构和视角深度在解释Tom分数时很重要。

blocks.en: Broader benchmarks add psychological diversity and conversational information asymmetry. OpenToM incorporates personality, preferences, intentions, and physical and psychological states ( Xu et al., 2024 ) . ToMBench organizes diverse social-cognitive tasks and abilities, while CogToM draws on paradigms inspired by human cognition ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Tong et al., 2026 ) . FANToM asks related questions about participants with unequal access to conversational information ( Kim et al., 2023 ) . ToMATO uses role-playing models’ private thoughts to construct questions about beliefs, intentions, desires, emotions, and knowledge ( Shinoda et al., 2025 ) . NegotiationToM studies beliefs, desires, and intentions in human negotiations ( Chan et al., 2024 ) . These constructions motivate reporting benchmark-specific results alongside capability groups.
blocks.zh: 更广泛的基准增加了心理多样性和对话信息不对称。 OpenTOM包含了个性,偏好,用意,以及身体和心理状态(徐等,2024. ToMBench组织各种各样的社会认知任务和能力,而CogTOM借鉴了受人类认知启发的范式(Chen等,2024;Tong等,2026). FANTOM询问相关参与者在获得谈话信息方面不平等的问题(Kim等,2023年). ToMATO使用角色扮演模型的私人思想构建关于信仰、意图、欲望、情感和知识的问题(Shinoda等,2025年)。 谈判 Tom研究人类谈判中的信仰、欲望和意图(Chan等,2024年)。 这些构建促使报告具体基准成果以及能力小组。

blocks.en: SimpleToM distinguishes mental-state inference from behavior prediction and judgment, exposing a gap between explicit attribution and implicit application ( Gu et al., 2026 ) . SimToM instead filters a story to information available to the queried character before answering a mental-state question ( Wilf et al., 2024 ) . Our application category follows the requested judgment, and the feedback intervention separates the contribution of a related question from that of a predicted mental state.
blocks.zh: SimpleTOM将精神状态推论与行为预测和判断区分开来,暴露出明确归属和隐含应用之间的差距(Gu等,2026.). SimTOM在回答一个精神状态问题之前,先将一个故事过滤到被询问的人物可获得的信息(Wilf等人,2024年). 我们的申请类别遵循所要求的判断,反馈干预将相关问题的贡献与预测的精神状态区分开来.

blocks.en: A.2 Jev evaluation and decision reliability
blocks.zh: A.2 Jev评价和决定的可靠性

blocks.en: TypeSafe introduces Jev as a model mapping unstructured state and typed questions to choices, scores, or probabilities ( Almeida, 2026 ; TypeSafe AI, 2026 ) . Across 37 datasets, Deußer et al. (2026) report strong results on many tasks but weaker performance for some label sets and judgment settings. The computational social science evaluation of Ibrahim and Zaki (2026) finds substantial gaps from the best LLM annotators on many tasks despite lower measured costs. These findings favor evaluation of the intended decision domain and label space.
blocks.zh: TypeSafe 介绍 Jev作为一个模型映射出无结构状态并打出问题来进行选择,分数,或概率(Almeida,2026;TypeSafe AI,2026.). 37个数据集 Deußer等人(2026年)报告在许多任务上取得了显著成果,但一些标签集和判断设置的性能较弱. 对Ibrahim和Zaki的计算社会科学评估(2026年)发现,尽管计量成本较低,但最佳LLM注释者在许多任务上存在很大差距。 这些结果有利于对预期的决定领域和标签空间进行评价。

blocks.en: Confidence routing depends on both the task and the fallback. Li et al. (2026) test accepting confident Jev verdicts and escalating uncertain cases, with gains weakening under style-adversarial inputs and reference-free prose. In rubric judging, Rao and Callison-Burch (2026) find shared errors between Jev and generative judges that limit accuracy gains from deferral. The annotation study likewise reports task-dependent confidence behavior ( Ibrahim and Zaki, 2026 ) . Our confidence analysis examines retained ToM answers without assuming that a fallback would correct them.
blocks.zh: 信心路由取决于任务和倒计时. 李等 (2026年)测试接受自信的Jev判决和不断升级的不确定案件,在风格-对抗性投入和无参考旁白下收益减弱. 在Rudric判断中,Rao和Callison-Burch(2026年)发现Jev和基因判断师之间有共同的错误,限制了从推迟中获得的精度收益. 笔记研究同样也报导了依任务而定的信心行为(Ibrahim and Zaki, 2026). 我们的信心分析研究了保留了Tom的答案,而没有假定回落会纠正这些答案。

blocks.en: Well-formed outputs can still reflect unintended request cues. JevAdvBench compares single-edit attacks with clean and repeated calls ( Hu et al., 2026 ) . Sun et al. (2026) show that option-name polarity can redirect selections under unchanged definitions. JevOut optimizes natural-looking contextual additions that redirect initially correct decisions, including on ToMBench ( Xu et al., 2026 ) . Our predefined reason attachments probe repair and damage without adversarial context search. Probability Contracts distinguishes valid reports, coherent probabilities, and downstream decisions ( Chen and Li, 2026 ) . An arithmetic rejection study further separates selecting an available answer from recognizing an answer-absent candidate set ( Zhong et al., 2026 ) . Together, this work motivates checking semantic selection, numerical validity, and candidate coverage separately.

blocks.en: JEVal extends general decision-model evaluation to bilingual domains, agent workflows, and social simulation, finding that fast local decisions can coexist with lower long-horizon success and aggregate prediction errors ( Duan et al., 2026 ) . It also introduces InnerJev through reasoning-to-readout self-distillation. PACT studies contrastive evidence, answer-code permutations, and calibration objectives for single-token decisions ( Lin, 2026 ) . These methods illustrate different routes to a decision interface rather than a common architecture for our five typed models.
blocks.zh: JEVal将一般决策模型评价扩展至双语领域,代理工作流程,以及社会模拟,发现快速的本地决策可以与较低的长视野成功和汇总预测错误并存(Duan等,2026年). 它还通过推理到读取自我分解引入了InnerJev. PACT研究了对比性证据,解码通路等,以及单接裁判的校正目标(Lin,2026). . 这些方法说明了决定界面的不同路线,而不是我们五个打入的模型的共同结构。

blocks.en: A.3 Multilingual and multimodal reasoning
blocks.zh: A.3 多语种和多模式推理

blocks.en: XToM constructs matched ToMi, FANToM, and NegotiationToM instances in English, Chinese, German, French, and Japanese through translation and human refinement ( Chan et al., 2026 ) . It distinguishes factual understanding from mental-state inference and finds that strong multilingual language understanding does not ensure comparable ToM performance across languages. A separate Jev cultural-values audit reports response and confidence changes across persona and language conditions ( Asseri and Asseri, 2026 ) . Both make language and social framing relevant evaluation dimensions beyond our English-only comparison.
blocks.zh: XTOM构造与TOM、FANTOM和谈判TOM的英文、中文、德文、法文和日文实例相符,通过翻译和人文改进(Chan等人,2026年)。 它将事实理解与精神状态推论区分开来,并发现强烈的多语种语言理解并不能确保各语言之间可比的Tom性能. 一个单独的Jev文化价值审计报告了对人和语言条件的反应和信心变化(Asseri和Asseri,2026年)。 使语言和社会框架相关评价层面超出我们仅与英文进行比较的范围。

blocks.en: MultivationBench studies motivations inferred from accumulated visual and textual narratives ( Chung et al., 2026 ) . Maslow’s expanded hierarchy of needs and Reiss’s basic desires support four multi-label tasks pairing theoretical definitions with context-specific motivation options. This design distinguishes recognizing a psychological category from grounding it in behavior as a story unfolds. Its results identify difficulties in fine-grained motivation selection and correct judgments across a narrative. It complements belief-centered evaluation through visual grounding, multi-label motivations, and evolving evidence, which our fixed text questions do not measure.
blocks.zh: 从累积的视觉和文字叙事中推断出的各种动机(Chung等,2026.). Maslow扩大的需求等级和Reiss的基本愿望支持四个多标签的任务,将理论定义与特定背景的动机选项相配合。 这种设计区分了在故事展开时识别一个心理类别和在行为中定位. 其成果查明了在精细的动机选择方面的困难,并纠正了叙述中的判断。 它通过视觉地基、多标签动机和不断演变的证据来补充以信仰为中心的评价,我们固定的文字问题无法衡量这些证据。

blocks.en: A.4 Mental-state reasoning in agents
blocks.zh: A.4 代理人的精神状态推理

blocks.en: Explicit belief representations support cooperative planning ( Li et al., 2023 ) . MindDial tracks speaker beliefs, predicted listener beliefs, and their differences for common-ground alignment and negotiation ( Qiu et al., 2024 ) . ToMA connects mental-state generation with dialogue lookahead and interactive goal achievement ( Hwang et al., 2026 ) . Mnemon assigns record-level judgments to Jev while an LLM plans retrieval and composes responses ( Wang, 2026 ) . These systems motivate evaluating repeated selection as a component alongside the surrounding interaction, as discussed in Appendix H .
blocks.zh: 明确信仰表达支持合作规划(李等,2023. MindDial追踪演说者的信仰,预测的听众信仰,以及他们对于共同点的一致和谈判的分歧(邱等,2024. ToMA将精神状态的生成与对话前瞻和互动目标实现联系起来(Hwang等,2026年)。 Mnemon将记录级的判断指派给Jev,而一个LLM则计划检索并作曲回复(Wang, 2026). . 如附录H所讨论,这些系统促使评价重复选择,将其作为与周围互动的一个组成部分。

blocks.en: B.1 Capability mapping

blocks.en: B.2 Datasets and harmonization
blocks.zh: B.2 数据集和统一

blocks.en: The common primary set contains 11,117 questions. We use normal-length discrete OpenToM, short-context discrete FANToM, English ToMBench, and the ToMi subset accompanying SimToM ( Wilf et al., 2024 ) , with fixed development or previously used subsets. Source adapters preserve contexts, references, candidate meanings, identifiers, and question families. Contexts are not truncated, and candidate order is frozen across models. From 11,167 initial questions, we exclude 50 BigToM percept-to-belief true-belief items whose stories omit the subsequent event required by the reference. Table 6 reports question, family, option, and context-length statistics.
blocks.zh: 共同的初级集包含11,117个问题. 我们使用正常长相离散的OpenTOM,短相离散的FANTOM,英语TOMBench,以及伴随SimTOM(Wilf等,2024)的TOMI子集,有固定的开发或以前使用的子集. 源适配器保存上下文,参考文献,候选含义,标识符,并询问家庭. 上下文不截断,候选顺序被冻结在模型之间。 从11,167个最初的问题中,我们排除了50个BigTOM 感知到信仰的真信物品,它们的故事省略了参考文献要求的随后事件. 表6列出问题、家庭、选择和背景统计。

blocks.en: B.3 Input, validation, and aggregation
blocks.zh: B.3 投入、验证和汇总

blocks.en: Typed models receive the context as state , the question as instructions , and indexed candidate texts, returning a choice and probabilities. Generative models receive the same content and return a candidate label. Strict scoring counts failed or unparseable outputs as wrong. Jev probabilities must cover exactly the offered choices, be finite and lie in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] , sum to one within 10 − 4 10^{-4} , and assign the selected choice a probability within 10 − 6 10^{-6} of the maximum. Confidence selection uses the selected-answer probability. Exact instructions and an input–output example appear in Appendix J .
blocks.zh: 类型模型作为状态、问题作为指示、以及将候选文本编入索引、返回选择和概率。 基因模型得到相同的内容并返回一个候选标签. 严格的评分计算失败或无法解析输出为错误 。 Jev概率必须精确地涵盖所提出的选择,必须是有限的,并存在于[0, 1][0, 1],总和在10-4 10- 4 10- 4] 以内,并且指定选择的概率在上限的10-6 10- 10- 6 以内。 信心选择使用所选答案概率. 准确的指令和输入-输出实例载于附录J。

blocks.en: Primary overall accuracy averages nine benchmark scores equally, including native controls and unmapped questions. Capability scores average contributing benchmarks and exclude controls and unassigned items. In the eight-model reason comparison, we average orders within questions, questions within benchmarks, and benchmarks equally. The six-condition intervention instead pools questions separately within each historical-correctness group. These weighting schemes remain distinct.
blocks.zh: 初级总体准确度平均为9个基准分数,包括本土控制和未标出的问题。 能力评分平均贡献基准,不包括控制和未分配项目。 在8个模型的理性比较中,我们平均在问题之内、在基准之内和在基准之内的顺序。 6个条件的干预将问题分别集中在每个历史正确组内。 这些加权办法仍然各不相同。

blocks.en: B.4 Models and settings
blocks.zh: B.4 模式和设置

blocks.en: Table 7 records the twelve models and their primary settings. Models receive one source question per request without task-specific fine-tuning. The six-condition study uses Jev, the full pair study uses eight models, matched candidates use Jev and GPT-3.5, and feedback uses five typed models. Resource settings are documented separately in Appendix G .
blocks.zh: 表7记录了十二种模型及其主要设置. 模型每个请求都收到一个源问题,而没有针对特定任务的微调. 六条件研究使用Jev,全对研究使用8个模型,匹配的考生使用Jev和GBT-3.5,反馈使用5个打入模型. 资源设置在附录G中单独记录。

blocks.en: B.5 Paired uncertainty estimates
blocks.zh: B.5 预测不确定性估计数

blocks.en: Within each benchmark, bootstrap sampling resamples source-defined families with replacement, retaining all questions, paired outcomes, and candidate orders together. Each draw recomputes the original statistic. We use 5,000 draws for primary, material, and feedback comparisons, 2,000 for the six-condition study, and 10,000 for matched candidates. Percentiles 2.5 and 97.5 define pointwise 95% intervals. Comparators remain fixed across draws. The estimates describe family-sampling variation, without adjustment for multiple comparisons or comparator selection, and do not measure repeated-inference or deployment variability. Complete estimates remain in the reproduction materials.
blocks.zh: 在每个基准内,靴子取样将源定义的家庭重新标出替换,保留所有问题,对结果进行配对,并列出候选订单。 每个绘图重算原始统计数据。 我们使用5 000个抽图进行初级、材料和反馈比较,2 000个用于六条件研究,10 000个用于匹配的候选人。 百分比为2.5和97.5,按点定出95%的间隔。 比较器仍然固定在平面上。 估计数描述了家庭抽样差异,没有为多重比较或参照者选择进行调整,也没有衡量重复推论或部署差异。 复制材料中尚有完整的估计数。

blocks.en: Appendix C Capability and Benchmark Results
blocks.zh: 附录C 能力和基准结果

blocks.en: C.1 Capability breakdowns
blocks.zh: C.1 能力细分

blocks.en: Tables 8 and 9 expand Figure 2 with benchmark–capability scores for all twelve models. Missing capability cells are omitted, while controls and unmapped questions enter only benchmark totals. This separates a model’s overall rank from its performance on the intended mental-state task.
blocks.zh: 表8和9扩展了图2,所有12个模型的基准能力分数。 缺失的能力单元格被省略,而控制和未填表的问题只输入基准总数. 这将一个模型的总体排名与其在意向的精神状态任务方面的表现区分开来。

blocks.en: C.2 Sensitivity to native controls
blocks.zh: C.2 对本土控制的敏感性

blocks.en: Table 10 removes 920 native controls: 600 BigToM, 132 FANToM, 30 Hi-ToM, and 158 ToMi questions. The remaining 10,197 questions retain all 505 unmapped CogToM items and equal benchmark weighting. Jev falls from 73.2% to 69.1%, while GPT-3.5 changes from 71.6% to 70.9%, reversing their order. Their paired difference is − 1.79 -1.79 points [ − 3.48 , − 0.07 ] [-3.48,-0.07] . ToMi contributes strongly to this reversal, with 50.0% for Jev and 83.3% for GPT-3.5 on its 96 non-control belief questions. The estimates use 5,000 within-benchmark family draws with seed 2026100401. ToMi retains 89 of its 220 families, and other benchmarks retain all families. The aggregate ranking consequently depends on whether native controls are included.
blocks.zh: 表10删除了920个本土控制:600个 BigTOM,132个FANTOM,30个Hi-TOM,158个TOMI问题. 其余10,197个问题保留了全部505个未放大的CogTOM项目和等同的基准权重. Jev从73.2%下降到69.1%,而GPT-3.5则从71.6%下降到70.9%,颠倒了它们的顺序. 它们成对相差为-1.79-1.79分[-3.48分,-0.07分] [-3.48分,-0.07分]. Tomi为这个倒转做出了很大贡献,Jev的倒转率为50.0%,GPT-3.5的倒转率为83.3%,其96个非控制信仰问题. 估计使用5000个内标家族取出2026100401种子. 托米保留了220个家庭中的89个,其他基准保留了所有家庭。 因此,综合排名取决于是否包括本土控制。

blocks.en: Appendix D Confidence-based Selection
blocks.zh: 附录D 基于信任的选择

blocks.en: D.1 Threshold and counts
blocks.zh: D.1 门槛和计数

blocks.en: The descriptive threshold of 0.90 applies to the probability assigned to the selected answer on all 11,117 Jev primary responses. Coverage divides retained answers by all questions in a benchmark. Retained error divides incorrect retained answers by retained answers. Table 11 gives the underlying counts for Figure 3 , including 33 retained Hi-ToM answers with no observed errors. The threshold is not a validated deployment policy.
blocks.zh: 0.90这一描述性阈值适用于所有11,117 Jev初级响应中选定答案的概率。 覆盖鸿沟保留了基准中所有问题的答案。 保留错误用保留答案分隔错误保留答案。 表11列出了图3的基本数字,包括33个未发现出错的Hi-Tom答复。 门槛不是经过验证的部署政策。

blocks.en: D.2 Risk–coverage curves
blocks.zh: D.2 风险覆盖曲线

blocks.en: Figure 9 extends the comparison across all observed thresholds. Equal probabilities are retained together, and empty selections have undefined error. OpenToM and SimpleToM have similar full-coverage error, 40.0% and 40.9%, but retaining about half their answers yields 23.3% error at 48.8% coverage and 35.3% at 48.9% coverage, respectively. Confidence therefore separates errors more effectively in the former comparison even though both retain substantial error.
blocks.zh: 图9将比较扩大到所有观察到的阈值。 等概率保留在一起,空选择有未定义的错误. OpenTOM和SimpleTOM也有类似的全覆盖错误,分别为40.0%和40.9%,但保留了大约一半的答案,分别得出了48.8%和35.3%的覆盖率。 因此,尽管前者存在重大错误,但信任能更有效地区分前者的错误。

blocks.en: Appendix E Reason Interference and Candidate Selection
blocks.zh: 附录E 理由干扰和候选人选择

blocks.en: E.1 Material construction
blocks.zh: E.1 材料建造

blocks.en: For the eight-model pair study, 4,761 materials comprise 1,803 reused questions with reasons and newly prepared reasons for 2,958 other existing questions. Generation and review use benchmark references to construct supporting reasons for original answers, including plausible but mistaken reasons for distractors. Review checks story support, queried perspective, attachment, and overt reference leakage. This selects experimental materials rather than establishing human correctness.
blocks.zh: 就8个模型的对等研究而言,4 761个材料包括1 803个重复使用的问题和2 958个其他现有问题的理由。 生成和审查使用基准参照,为原始答案构建支持性理由,包括转移注意力者的可信但错误的理由。 审查检查故事支持,询问视角,附件,以及公开的参考泄漏. 这选择了实验材料,而不是建立人的正确性.

blocks.en: Generation and separate review use GPT-6.1-Sol with JSON output. Newly prepared materials specify temperature 0, at most max ⁡ ( 1600,200 ​ K ) \max(1600,200K) generation tokens for K K options, and 1,600 review tokens. Only service failures permit repeat requests. The exact generation and review prompts appear in Appendix J.3 .
blocks.zh: 生成和单独审查使用带有JSON输出的GPT-6.1-Sol. 新制备的材料指定了温度为0,最多为QQ(1600,200 K)\max(1600,200K)为K选项的生成令牌,以及1600个审查令牌. 只有服务故障才允许重复请求. 确切的生成和审查提示载于附录J.3。

blocks.en: E.2 Six-condition answer selection
blocks.zh: E.2 6个条件的答案选择

blocks.en: Figure 4 uses the 1,803 retained reused materials, comprising 249 historically correct and 1,554 historically incorrect Jev answers. Material screening starts with 531 correct and 2,533 incorrect cases. Generation and initial screening retain 2,142 cases, and subsequent review retains 1,803. Historical correctness defines the groups, while fresh no-reason calls provide their baselines.
blocks.zh: 图4采用了1,803个被保留再利用的材料,包括249个历史上正确和1,554个历史上不正确的Jev答案。 材料检查开始时有531个正确病例,2 533个错误病例. 生成和初步筛选保留了2 142起病例,随后的审查保留了1 803起。 历史正确性界定了各群体,而新的无正当理由呼叫则提供了它们的基线。

blocks.en: Each question retains its original answers under six conditions: no reasons, identical neutral filler, aligned reasons, swapped keyed/foil reasons, the keyed reason repeated on every answer, and the foil repeated on every answer. The foil supports Jev’s earlier incorrect choice, or the first non-keyed option for earlier-correct questions. Swapping changes only the keyed and foil attachments. Original and reversed orders are pooled separately within each historical group. Instructions and neutral text appear in Appendix J.2 . Complete plotted values remain in the reproduction materials.
blocks.zh: 每个问题在六个条件下保留了最初的答案:没有原因,相同的中性填充器,一致的原因,交换了按键/花样原因,每个答案重复了按键原因,每个答案重复了挫败. 阴道支持 Jev 先前错误的选择, 或第一个非键选项, 用于较早正确的问题 。 拆分只改变被键和被挫败的附属物. 原订单和倒置订单在每一历史组别内单独集合. 说明和中文本见附录J.2。 复制材料中仍保留完整的绘图值。

blocks.en: E.3 Human annotation
blocks.zh: E.3 人的注释

blocks.en: Three postgraduate coauthors at English-medium universities, with prior ToM annotation experience, annotated in English as research collaborators without additional annotation payment. Written English–Chinese instructions and a label guide supported the procedure. Figure 10 preserves the complete interface excerpts.
blocks.zh: 3名研究生合著者在英语中专大学就读,拥有之前的Tom注解经验,英语注解为研究合作者而无需追加注解费. 英文-中文书面说明和标签指南支持这一程序。 图10保存了完整的界面节录.

blocks.en: The initial sample contains 50 questions per benchmark, totaling 450 questions and 1,879 reasons, stratified by material origin and option count without model predictions. Each annotator initially assessed 270 questions. All three shared 90 questions and 374 reasons, while 180 further questions had two annotations and 180 had one. A later answer-only stage collected 450, 450, and 270 judgments without adding reason labels. A follow-up covered all 249 earlier-correct intervention questions with three human judgments each. Nineteen exact-material overlaps yield 680 unique questions across stages. Table 12 summarizes coverage and majority outcomes.
blocks.zh: 初始样本包含每个基准的50个问题,共计450个问题和1,879个原因,按物质来源分级,选项计数没有模型预测. 每个注释员最初评估了270个问题。 所有三个问题共有90个问题和374个理由,而另外180个问题有两个说明,180个有一个说明。 后来一个只回答的阶段收集了450个,450个和270个判决,但没有增加理由标签. 后续行动涵盖所有249个先前正确的干预问题,每个问题有3个人类判断。 十九个精确的材料重叠产生680个不同阶段的独特问题。 表12总结了覆盖面和多数成果。

blocks.en: Annotators first answered from the story, question, and ordered options, recording evidence before reasons were revealed. Later revisions were saved separately. References, model predictions, machine review, and material origin were hidden. Story-support labels were SUPPORTED , CONTRADICTED , NOT_ESTABLISHED , or UNCERTAIN . Attachment labels were YES , NO , or UNCERTAIN , asking whether the reason, if true, supported its answer. Non- SUPPORTED / YES judgments required a note. Answer judgments also allowed MULTIPLE , NONE , or UNCERTAIN .
blocks.zh: 注释者首先从故事中回答,质问,并点出选项,记录证据后才会揭示原因. 后来的修改被单独保存. 参考资料、模型预测、机器审查和材料来源被隐藏起来。 支持故事的标签是支持的, 封闭的, 不建立, 或UNCERDEC。 附件中的标签是 " 是 " 、 " 否 " 或 " UNCERPAIN " ,询问如果是,理由是否支持其答案。 不支持/ " 是 " 判决需要说明。 答复判决还允许MULTIPLE、NONE或UNCRED。

blocks.en: For the initial two-annotator comparison on 374 shared reasons, story-support agreement was 85.56% (Cohen’s κ = 0.768 \kappa=0.768 ) and attachment agreement 95.19% ( κ = 0.833 \kappa=0.833 ). The later answer-only stage had mean pairwise agreement of 82.47% on 270 questions shared by all three (Fleiss’ κ = 0.751 \kappa=0.751 ). On the 90 initially shared questions, all three endorsed the keyed reason and attachment on 75, while at least one endorsed an alternative answer–reason pair on 30. Agreement and endorsement do not establish correctness or complete adjudication.
blocks.zh: 对于最初的374个共同原因的两位注释者比较,故事支持协议为85.56%(Cohen's $ 0.768\kappa=0.768)和附件协议为95.19%(U = 0.833\kappa=0.833). 后一个只回答阶段对全部三个问题共有的270个问题(Fleiss ' $ = 0.751\kappa=0.751 ) , 平均为82.47 % 。 在最初共有的90个问题上,所有三个问题都认可了75个问题的密钥解释和附件,而至少一个问题认可了30个问题的替代答案。 协议和认可没有确立正确性或完整的裁定。

blocks.en: The post-hoc follow-up analysis establishes an answer-category reference when at least two of three annotators choose the same single category. For the first two annotators it uses the revised answer after reason review, or the initial answer if unchanged. The third vote comes from the independent record saved before other judgments were shown. Non-single-category judgments remain outside this subset. Of 249 questions, 219 have majority references, including 211 unanimous cases, and all 219 match the benchmark categories. The remaining 30 stay in the annotation records.
blocks.zh: 当三个注释者中至少有两个选择同一个单一类别时,之后的跟踪分析建立了答案类参考. 对于前两个注释者,它使用经过理性审查后的订正答案,或者如果没有改变,使用初始答案。 第三次投票来自在其他判决显示之前保存的独立记录。 非单一类别判决仍然不属于这一子集。 在249个问题中,219个问题有多数提及,包括211个一致案件,所有219个问题都符合基准类别。 其余30人留在注解记录中.

blocks.en: Table 12 retains both candidate orders and strict scoring, yielding 438 responses per condition on the majority subset. Aligned reasons raise accuracy from 98.2% to 100.0%, while swapped reasons lower it to 24.9%. The paired changes are + 1.8 +1.8 and − 73.3 -73.3 points, with family-bootstrap intervals [ 0.5 , 3.6 ] [0.5,3.6] and [ − 77.6 , − 68.9 ] [-77.6,-68.9] . Reason attachment therefore remains consequential on questions whose answer categories receive human majority support. The detailed annotation joins and exploratory R/K/S screens remain in the reproduction materials.
blocks.zh: 表12保留了候选人的顺序和严格的评分,在多数子集中,每个条件得到438份答复。 一致的理由将精度从98.2%提高到了100.0%,而互换的理由则将其降低到24.9%. 成对变化为+1.8+1.8和−73.3-73.3分,并有出家间隔[0.5,3.6] [0.5,3.6]和[−77.6,-68.9] [-77.6,-68.9]. 因此,在回答类别得到多数人支持的问题上,理由依附仍然是必然的结果。 详细的注释加入和探索性R/K/S屏幕保留在复制材料中。

blocks.en: E.4 Material selection, repair, and damage
blocks.zh: E.4 材料的选择、修理和损坏

blocks.en: Table 13 supplies absolute reused/new accuracies for Figure 5 , together with Jev’s paired repair and damage contributions. Repair changes a wrong no-reason outcome to a correct one, while damage changes a correct outcome to a wrong one. Both use all weighted outcomes, so the net change combines repair and signed damage, rather than conditioning on earlier errors or successes. On new materials, Jev’s aligned change is + 3.69 +3.69 points [ 1.93 , 5.51 ] [1.93,5.51] , while its crossed change is − 0.40 -0.40 [ − 3.03 , 2.17 ] [-3.03,2.17] . blocks.zh: 表13提供了图5的绝对再利用/新速率,以及Jev的对等修复和损坏贡献。 修复将错误的无正当理由结果改为正确的结果,而损害则将正确的结果改为错误的结果。 两者都使用所有加权结果,因此净变化结合了修复和签名损坏,而不是以先前的错误或成功为条件. 在新材料上,Jev的对接变化为+3.69+3.69分 [1.93, 5.51] [1.93.5.51],而其交叉变化为-0.40-0.40 [-3.03, 2.17] [-3.03,2.17]. 观测到的小变化仍然是描述性的,从零到零的间隔不能确定等同性。

blocks.en: E.5 Matched candidates

blocks.en: The capability profiles and resource comparisons motivate testing Jev as a selector in dialogue and collaborative agents ( Qiu et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2023 ) . An LLM could propose partner-state interpretations from dialogue history and generate responses while Jev selects among them ( Yao et al., 2023 ) . Emotions and social pragmatics are promising starting points given Jev’s observed domain scores, while belief attribution and application leave more room for improvement.
blocks.zh: 能力简介和资源比较促使Jev作为对话与合作代理人的选择者进行测试(邱等,2024;李等,2023)。 一个LLM可以从对话历史中提出伙伴国家的解释,并生成答复,而Jev则从中选择(Yao等人,2023年)。 鉴于Jev观察到的域分数,情感和社会实用主义是很有希望的起点,而信仰的归属和应用则有更大的改进余地。

blocks.en: Candidates should distinguish the partner’s perspective from the agent’s information and be revised as evidence changes. Evaluate candidate coverage separately from selection accuracy when a correct interpretation is present. Reason interference motivates checking attachment and candidate sensitivity, while task-specific calibration can guide acceptance and clarification ( Ren et al., 2023 ) . Invalid outputs need a fallback. These component checks support a proposed integration study, with dialogue quality and collaborative task success evaluated in the complete system.
blocks.zh: 候选人应当将合伙人的观点与代理人的信息区分开来,并随着证据的变化而修改. 在有正确解释时,对候选人的覆盖范围和甄选的准确性分别进行评估。 理性干扰促使检查附着物和候选物的敏感性,而针对特定任务的校正可以指导接受和澄清(Ren等,2023. 无效输出需要倒计时 。 这些组成部分的检查有助于拟议的综合研究,在完整的系统中评价对话质量和合作任务的成功。

blocks.en: Primary generative system instruction Answer the multiple-choice question using the given context. Choose the most likely answer. Return only its option label, with no explanation.

blocks.en: J.2 Reason-intervention instructions
blocks.zh: J.2 理由干预指示

blocks.en: Answer-only selects an original answer. Joint selection uses Answer: and Reason: fields, with generative IDs C000 , C001 , etc. The six-condition study selects the answer itself, with added text following Suggested reason: . Neutral filler is identical across answers.
blocks.zh: 只回答选择一个原始答案。 联合选取使用Answer:和Reason:字段,有基因ID C000 , C001等. 6个条件的研究选择答案本身,添加的文字按照建议的理由:. 中立的填充器在答题上是一样的

blocks.en: Answer-only instruction Select the answer best supported by the original story and the question.
blocks.zh: 仅回答指令 选择由原故事和问题最佳支持的答案。

blocks.en: Joint answer–reason instruction Select the single candidate whose answer AND attached reason are both best supported by the original story and the question. Evaluate the complete answer-and-reason pair: a correct answer with an incorrect reason, or a correct reason attached to an incorrect answer, is not a fully correct candidate. Reasons are claims to evaluate, not additional story facts. Select one of the supplied complete candidates.
blocks.zh: 联合答复-理由说明 选择单项候选人,其答案和所附带的理由既得到了原故事的最佳支持,也得到了问题的最佳支持. 评价完整的答案和理由组合:正确答案和不正确理由,或错误答案所附正确理由,不是一个完全正确的候选人。 理由就是声称要评价,而不是额外的故事事实. 选择一个完整的候选人。

blocks.en: Six-condition answer-selection instruction Select the answer itself. Any suggested reason attached to an option is an untrusted explanation to evaluate, not an additional story fact. An incorrect suggested reason does not automatically make its answer incorrect.
blocks.zh: 6个条件的回答选择指示 选择答案本身。 任何附在备选方案上的建议理由都是不可信的评估解释,而不是另一个故事事实。 提出的不正确理由不会自动使其答案不正确。

blocks.en: Neutral filler The proposed answer concerns the person and situation in the story. Read the context and question carefully before deciding which available answer to select here.
blocks.zh: 中立填充器 拟议答案涉及故事中的人物和情况。 仔细阅读上下文并提问,然后决定在此选择哪一个可用的答案 。

blocks.en: J.3 Reason generation and review
blocks.zh: J.3 理由的产生和审查

blocks.en: The generation prefix is followed by the story, question, original ordered options, and benchmark reference. The review case also includes the generated reasons. Evaluated models do not receive the reference field.
blocks.zh: 生成前缀之后是故事,问题,原订选项,以及基准参考. 审查案件还包括产生的理由。 被评估的模型没有收到引用字段 。

blocks.en: Full-corpus reason generation Create one explanation for EACH original answer option, in exactly the original option order, for a Theory-of-Mind experimental intervention. Use only the supplied story, question and queried character/time/perspective. The benchmark gold is supplied for material construction only. The gold explanation must support the gold answer from the story. Each nongold explanation must affirmatively support its OWN attached answer through a concrete plausible but mistaken observation or inference. Do not refute that option or announce that it is wrong. Do not reveal the answer key, labels, indices, benchmark status or preferred option. Avoid stereotyped conditional wording only in distractors. Use similar style and length across all options (aim for 25-50 English words each). Check nested beliefs and information access carefully. If the gold cannot reasonably be supported, set usable=false and state the uncertainty. Do not invent evidence to force it. Still provide one explanation per option. These are claims to evaluate, not new story facts. Return a JSON object only: {"id": string, "usable": boolean, "reasons": [string per option], "evidence": string, "caveat": string}. CASE:
blocks.zh: 全军的理性创造 为 EACH 最初的答案选项创建一个解释, 完全按照最初的选项顺序, 用于一个 Mind 理论实验干预. 只使用提供的故事,询问和询问字符/时间/前景. 基准黄金仅供材料建造之用。 黄金解释必须支持故事中的黄金答案. 每个非黄金解释都必须通过具体、可信但错误的观察或推论,肯定地支持其所附的自发性回答。 不要反驳这个选择或宣布它是错误的。 不显示答案键、标签、索引、基准状态或首选选项。 只在分散注意力者中避免定型的有条件措辞。 在所有选项中使用相近的样式和长度(每个英文单词Aim). 仔细检查嵌入的信仰和信息访问. 如果黄金无法得到合理支持,则设定可用=虚假,并说明不确定性。 不要发明证据来强迫它。 仍提供每个选项的一个解释。 这些是用来评价的,不是新的故事事实。 只返回 JSON 对象 : {"id":字符串, "可用":布尔, "理由": [每个选项的字符串], "证据":字符串, "caveat": string}. 案例:

blocks.en: Material-review rubric You are an independent material reviewer for a Theory-of-Mind option-rationale intervention. Review the supplied original story, question, original answer options, benchmark gold answer and the generated explanations. You are checking whether this material is a sound experimental intervention, not whether the benchmark or Jev is right. Check every option, not only the gold answer: 1. The gold explanation must support the gold answer using the supplied story, queried person, time and perspective. Nested beliefs must address the requested mental-state holder and observer. Record material uncertainty when support is insufficient. Do not label the benchmark definitively defective. 2. Each nongold explanation is intentionally mistaken. It must affirmatively support its own attached candidate through a concrete erroneous inference or observation. Do not reject merely because it contradicts the story: deliberate error is required. Reject explanations that instead refute their attached answer, give the correct answer, explicitly acknowledge their own error, or fail to support their attached option. 3. Verify original option order, rationale count and answer mapping. Reject correctness leakage, an obvious label cue, or material that cannot implement the intended comparison. 4. Record minor length or style imbalance as warnings. Do not reject for a small deviation from the suggested 25–50 English words alone. Exclude only a concrete validity defect or unresolved material uncertainty. Do not repair, rewrite, or replace the original artifact. 5. Do not consult Jev outcomes, prior review judgments, historical success or the material generator’s identity. All judgments must use the case below. This is gold-informed machine review, not human annotation or a measurement of Jev’s internal reasoning. Return JSON with id, approved (boolean), issues (list of concrete rejection reasons), warnings (list of residual limitations). A rejection must have an issue. An approval must have no unresolved validity issue. Review the full case before deciding.
blocks.zh: 材料审查主题 你是一个独立的材料审查员 一个思维理论 - 选项 - 定量干预。 审查所提供的原始故事,问题,原始答案选项,基准黄金答案和所生成的解释. 您正在检查这些材料是否是一种良好的实验性干预,而不是基准或Jev是否正确。 检查每个选项, 不仅仅是黄金答案: 1. 黄金解释必须用所提供的故事、询问人、时间和观点来支持黄金回答。 隐蔽的信仰必须针对被请求的精神状态持有者和观察者. 在支助不足时记录实质性不确定性。 不要给基准贴上绝对有缺陷的标签。 2. 每个非黄金解释都是故意错误的。 它必须通过具体错误的推论或观察,肯定地支持它自己的候选人。 不要仅仅因为它与故事相矛盾而拒绝:需要蓄意错误。 拒绝反驳其所附答案、给出正确答案、明确承认自己的错误或不支持其所附选择的解释。 3. 验证原始选项顺序、理由计算和答案映射。 拒绝正确性泄漏、明显的标签提示或无法执行预期比较的材料。 4. 记录小长度或样式不平衡作为警告。 仅凭25-50个英文单词,不要拒绝稍有偏离。 仅排除具体有效性缺陷或未解决的物质不确定性。 不修复,重写,或者更换原出品. 5. 不要查阅Jev结果、事先审查判决、历史成就或材料生成者的身份。 所有判决必须使用以下案件。 这是金通的机器评论,不是人类的注释,也不是对Jev内部推理的衡量. 带ID返回JSON,批准(布尔),问题(具体拒绝理由清单),警告(剩余限制清单). 拒绝必须有一个问题。 批准不得有任何未决的有效性问题。 在作出裁决之前审查整个案件。

blocks.en: J.4 Mental-state feedback suffixes
blocks.zh: J.4 心理状态反馈后缀

blocks.en: Suffixes follow two newline characters. Newlines separate the question label, question, attribution, and selected answer text. Predicted and flipped conditions differ only in which upstream answer text is supplied, without references or probabilities.
blocks.zh: 后缀跟随两个新行字符. 新行将问题标签、问题、归属和选定的答案文本分开。 所预测的和被翻转的条件仅在提供上游答案文本时不同,没有参考文献或概率。
